tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Implement sqlglot.report_inspection.query_copy, physical_nodes and inspect_tables(query,*,dialect=None) returning frozen TableReference(catalog,database,name,alias,quoted,scope) occurrences. Parse exactly one Query or copy supplied Query; reject empty/multiple/nonquery input. Use actual traverse_scope to exclude CTE references (including shadowing), retain physical tables inside CTE bodies, nested subqueries, self joins and SEMI/ANTI RHS. Preserve exact identifier case and catalog/db/name quote flags, scope traversal order and input AST/parent links. Ignore table functions/dynamic names rather than labeling them physical tables. Do not use regex table extraction or schema guesses.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_sg_tables_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-sg-tables-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Implement sqlglot.report_binding.parameter_names(tree) and bind_parameters(query,values,*,strict=True,dialect=None) on completed single-query copies. Replace named Placeholder nodes with real exp literal conversions, repeated uses get independent nodes; literals/comments/identifiers containing colon text stay unchanged. Support None/bool/int/finite float/finite Decimal/str/bytes/date/time/datetime and recursive lists, reject nonfinite/cyclic/unsupported objects and SQL Expr values. Missing parameters always fail; strict rejects extras, nonstrict ignores unused values. Reject positional placeholders explicitly and preserve original AST parents. Never parse parameter text as SQL.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_sg_bind_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-sg-bind-dev.md. Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Implement sqlglot.report_bounds.bounded_query(query,max_rows,*,offset=0,dialect=None) using completed single-query copying and real AST builders. Wrap original query as an aliased subquery and apply outer limit/offset; never overwrite existing inner LIMIT/OFFSET/order/CTEs or apply limit independently to each UNION branch. Accept zero limit, reject negative/noninteger/bool values, preserve original AST and compile through requested output dialect. This bounds final row count, does not execute SQL or guarantee implicit order across dialects.
